meta.description: Turns paths into the surface around them with a fibrous relief along them. Paths of different bodies get their own surfaces. Every node that made paths is its own material group. Paths from set_color bring the color of their points: it goes along the surface, a gradient of alpha too, and over smoothly where paths of two colors meet.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Paths that grow into one body of tissue, like stipe and cap: the gaps between them fill. Paths from set_fill with a fill of 0 keep their gaps open, like gills or the veil

bodies.label: Bodies
bodies.description: The paths the paths grew on, like the stipes with the rays of their caps. Paths that grew on different stipes keep their own surfaces and don't fill into one, so the caps of a cluster stay apart. Without it all paths are one body

resolution_field.description: How many cells the surface is built from along the longest side of the body, from the setting resolution.field. More is finer and slower.

fibres.description: Relief along the paths. Paths from set_fibres bring their own.

fill.description: Where a ball of this many path radii can't pass between body paths the gap fills, so single paths only show as fibres. 0 shows every path. Paths from set_fill bring their own.
